comments.author: @Second_Stage_Anomaly
comments.text: West Aussie here, this is a great video and more accurate than I was expecting. As one of the 20% of people that lives outside of Perth, it's undoubtedly a great and beautiful place to live, but this video's comments on the isolation are very true. I'm trying to get into university soon, and to go anywhere worthwhile I need to move a minimum of 600km away from where I am now to get to Perth. However Perth unis don't have the exact degree I'm looking for, so if I end up doing those, that's a further ~3,300km away. That's a bloody long way even by Australian standards, but watching this video has made it occur to me that for people elsewhere in the world even needing to go just the 600km to find the nearest university might sound crazy, but there's a significant lack of opportunity in most other places. We make the trip down reasonably often just to go shopping etc. Nonetheless, WA is the place to be and making the decision to move east will be a hard one. I've travelled around a lot of it but there'll always be more to see.
